question: Which of the following organisations publishes the ‘WORLD ECONOMIC OUTLOOK’ report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Monetary Fund.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****International Monetary Fund:**

__
 
• It is an international financial institution with headquarters in** Washington, D.C. **and membership from **190 nations.** It is a major **UN financial agency.**
 
• **Goal**:
 
 
• Working to foster global monetary cooperation, **secure financial stability**, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and s**ustainable economic growth,** and reduce poverty around the world.
 
 
 
• Founded in **1944 **and inaugurated on **December 27, 1945**, at the **Bretton Woods Conference**, primarily on the basis of the concepts of **John Maynard Keynes and Harry Dexter White,**
 
• With **29 member nations** and the goal of rebuilding the international **monetary system**, it was officially established in** 1945.**
 
• It now plays a crucial role in the management of** international financial crises **and issues with the balance of payments.
 
• It published **World Economic Outlook 2022. *Hence option 2 is correct.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **World Economic Outlook 2022:**

 
• The world is headed for a** global recession** and prolonged stagnation, according to the WEO report 2022, unless advanced economies quickly change their current policy of **monetary and fiscal **tightening.
 
• The report focuses primarily on the **supply-side shocks**, falling investor and consumer confidence, and the conflict in Ukraine.
 
• **Inflationary pressures** and a global slowdown have been brought on by these factors.
 
• **Main Highlights** are as follows:
 
 
• **Global Growth Projections:** Global growth is expected to decrease from 6.0% in 2021 to 3.2% in 2022 and 2.7% in 2023, according to projections.
 
• **Inflation:** The global inflation rate is expected to rise from 4.7% in 2021 to 8.8% in 2022 before falling to 6.5 per cent in 2023 and 4.1% in 2024, according to forecasts.
 
• **Global Economic Challenges: **In the first half of 2022, a decline in the US economy.
